question: How much notice does Rohan Sharma need to give to terminate his contract?
note: Week 11 drill (complaint: 'a lawyer said it cited the wrong clause on termination, maybe Thursday'). Asked by name, not contract id, so search fetched PC-2026-011 §8 (60 days, superseded) and Mendis's PC-2026-027 §8, never the amendment AMD-PC-011-01 §3 that made it 90 days. The answer cited the superseded clause. The judge cannot catch this: the clause it cited really does say 60 days.

observed.answer: Rohan Sharma needs to give 60 days written notice to terminate his contract [3].
